localChanges: chore: update civ1-unit, simple-ai-client and base-unit-action-plant-forest

log: PlantForest asked for a Horse feature on the new Forest, which only Plains can have (civ-clone/web-renderer#260). The lockfile is refreshed with the new dependency.

Replace the per-action multiplier of the terrain's move cost with v474.05's table (irrigate/mine costs per terrain; roads 2x and railroads 4x the move cost), exported as civ1TerrainJobTurns and terrainJobTurns(). The engine's figure is Civ1's less one, since Civ1 counts the turn the order is given on (civ-clone/web-renderer#261).

The Civ1 terrain policy used its own copy of civ1-unit's old multipliers. It now asks terrainJobTurns, so a job's length matches the engine (civ-clone/web-renderer#261). With irrigation slower, a road on a worked tile now comes first in the TerrainWork fixture, and the tests follow it.
